info.title: ccu-addon-longpressdim API
info.description: The addon's own API, served at /addons/longpressdim/api/v1/ behind the system's session. Writes carry the kit's CSRF header X-CCU-Addon-Request and, where marked, need an administrator session. Every write to the system (links, link parameters, names and markers of the virtual keys) is planned first: POST bindings/plan answers the dry run that POST bindings executes.
